On the 3 samples with a documented ground truth (13 known vulnerabilities): TerrARA reports 13/13 covered with 488 threats (37.5 per covered vulnerability). This pipeline: **1** on an attack path or a plan-confirmed threat, **6** counting a yes/no question on the right resource, 6 counting generic threats; 106 items to read (17.7 per covered vulnerability), 18 on the first screen.

## cloudgoat-glue_privesc

| Vulnerability | Layer | Covered by | Detail |
|---|---|---|---|
| GP-1 SQL injection in the web page on EC2 exposes the Glue manager's access keys stored in RDS | app | **asked** | question 1: aws_instance.linux_ec2 validatesInput |
| GP-2 the Glue manager can pass a role to a new Glue job and read the SSM parameter through it | cloud | **none** |  |

## awsgoat-module-1

| Vulnerability | Layer | Covered by | Detail |
|---|---|---|---|
| AG1-1 reflected XSS in the blog's search | app | **asked** | question 9: aws_lambda_function.lambda_ba_data validatesInput |
| AG1-2 injection in the users search returns every user's record | app | **asked** | question 9: aws_lambda_function.lambda_ba_data validatesInput |
| AG1-3 IDOR lets any user change another user's password | app | **none** |  |
| AG1-4 an unauthenticated API endpoint dumps all users' data | app+cloud | **none** |  |
| AG1-5 SSRF in the post image URL reads local files of the Lambda environment | app | **asked** | question 9: aws_lambda_function.lambda_ba_data validatesInput |
| AG1-6 SSRF reads the Lambda's role credentials, whose dynamodb:* on * lets the attacker add an admin user to the users table | app+cloud | **asked** | question 9: aws_lambda_function.lambda_ba_data validatesInput |
| AG1-7 a public dev bucket leaks an SSH key; the EC2 role can attach policies to the Lambda role and update its code, reaching account admin | cloud | **confirmed** | AC01@aws_s3_bucket.dev, TAPM-EC2-01@aws_instance.goat_instance, TAPM-EC2-02@aws_instance.goat_instance |

## awsgoat-module-2

| Vulnerability | Layer | Covered by | Detail |
|---|---|---|---|
| AG2-1 SQL injection on the login page | app | **none** |  |
| AG2-2 unrestricted file upload gives a shell in the task, and task metadata gives the task role's credentials | app+cloud | **none** |  |
| AG2-3 SYS_PTRACE lets the shell break out of the container and read the host's role credentials from IMDS | app+cloud | **none** |  |
| AG2-4 the ECS instance role has IAMFullAccess, so its credentials can create an administrator | cloud | **none** |  |
